summary: Lasting Smile has operated since 1998, with WhatsApp in several places. Leftover template details undermine trust right where patients decide.

findings.problem: The counters (Years of Experience, Happy Patients, Expert Dentists, review score) show 0 as I saw them. The page also gives 28 years and 25 years, and 517 reviews and 527 reviews.
findings.cost: Zeros and conflicting numbers make patients doubt every claim on the page.
findings.fix: One verified set of numbers, shown correctly.

findings.problem: All four doctor profile links appear to point to a third party demo domain (demo.awaikenthemes.com), and the slugs do not match the doctors named.
findings.cost: A patient who clicks a doctor and lands on a template demo loses trust in the whole clinic.
findings.fix: Real profile pages for every doctor.

findings.problem: The footer phone label shows 920010617 but its link points to a different number. Leftover image labels such as Home 3 and Home 13 remain.
findings.cost: A phone link that dials the wrong number loses calls, and leftover labels make the page look unfinished.
findings.fix: Correct phone links and a clean, finished page.

findings.problem: No testimonials are visible, the before and after images have no captions, the blog has no posts and Friday hours are missing.
findings.cost: Patients choose on visible results and clear hours. An empty proof section sends them to a clinic that shows both.
findings.fix: Real reviews, captioned results and complete opening hours.

redesign: A proof first homepage with accurate numbers, real doctor profiles and captioned results beside every booking button.
A short booking form plus WhatsApp using reliable links, so a patient books in under 30 seconds.
